A DOM raw-HTML sink receives unescaped, non-literal content without a sanitizer.

loadChatWindow builds GET messages/chat?otherUser=<user.name> where otherUser is attacker-controlled (picked from the user list). It reads the private message thread selected by that untrusted identifier and renders it, with no source-side check binding the requested thread to the authenticated session (current user exists only in the cookie/session); the object-access key is passed straight into the backend object lookup.
